edition.notes: Printed among the Constitutiones Apostolicae of the Acta Francisci in the March 2015 fascicle. The Acta prints no incipit title, only the rubric.
edition.title: In Erythraea nova constituitur Ecclesia Metropolitana Asmarensis - Acta text

passages.context: The operative clause: a Metropolitana sui iuris archieparchia Neanthopolitana seiungimus eparchias Asmarensem, Barentuanam, Kerensem et Segheneitensem ... novam Metropolitanam Ecclesiam sui iuris Asmarensem appellandam constituimus; dated die undevicesimo mensis Ianuarii anno Domini bismillesimo quinto decimo.
passages.notes: Corroborated by the Erectio Ecclesiarum record at AAS 107 (2015) 1075 in the October 2015 fascicle, which also records the erection of the Hungarian metropolitan Church sui iuris on 20 March 2015.

work.author: Francis
work.description: The apostolic constitution of 19 January 2015 by which Francis detached the eparchies of Asmara, Barentu, Keren, and Segheneity from the metropolitan archieparchy of Addis Ababa and erected the Eritrean Metropolitan Church sui iuris, raising Asmara to a metropolitan archieparchy.
work.title: In Erythraea nova constituitur Ecclesia Metropolitana Asmarensis
